events.name: Boston Red Sox at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Anthony Seigler hit a go-ahead triple in the ninth inning, and the Boston Red Sox beat the Miami Marlins 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Seigler hits go-ahead triple in 9th and Red Sox beat Marlins 4-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Jonathan Aranda homered and Drew Rasmussen gave up three hits in six strong innings as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the slumping Detroit Tigers 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aranda's home run and Rasmussen's six strong innings lead Rays past slumping Tigers, 4-1

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams had the go-ahead RBI in a five-run fifth inning, Cade Cavalli won his fourth consecutive start and the Washington Nationals defeated Colorado 13-3 on Monday night to send the Rockies to their season-worst seventh consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals roll to 13-3 victory and extend Rockies' losing streak to season-high 7 games

events.name: Texas Rangers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Corey Seager had three hits and three RBI, and Jake Burger and Wyatt Langford homered to lead the Texas Rangers to an 11-2 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Corey Seager sparks offense as Rangers rout White Sox 11-2 to grab AL West lead

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Parker Messick pitched six innings of one-run ball and Austin Hedges hit a two-run homer in the Cleveland Guardians’ 4-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messick throws 6 strong innings and Hedges hits 2-run homer as Guardians beat Angels 4-2

headlines.description: — Michael Conforto and Carson Kelly hit back-to-back homers, Kevin Gausman gave up just three hits over seven innings and the Chicago Cubs beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 7-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conforto and Kelly hit back-to-back HRs, lift the Cubs over the Diamondbacks 7-0

headlines.description: — Zebby Matthews allowed six hits and one run over seven innings, Josh Bell drove in three runs, and the Minnesota Twins beat the Athletics 9-6 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zebby Matthews and Josh Bell lift Minnesota Twins to 9-6 win over Athletics

headlines.description: — Cal Raleigh hit three home runs and the Seattle Mariners stopped Philadelphia's season-best winning streak at nine games with a 9-2 victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cal Raleigh hits 3 homers as Mariners snap Phillies' 9-game win streak with 9-2 victory

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Nick Gonzales led off the 12th inning with an RBI single and the Pittsburgh Pirates snapped their three-game skid with a 3-2 victory over the San Diego Padres on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Gonzales' 12th-inning RBI single sends Pirates past Padres 3-2

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers hit a three-run homer in the second inning and the San Francisco Giants snapped a four-game losing streak by beating the Cincinnati Reds 5-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers hits three-run homer to highlight Giants' 5-0 win over Reds, San Francisco ends skid
